description: For functions \(f,g\) and a filter \(\mathcal F\), eventual domination means \(\{x:f(x)\le g(x)\}\in\mathcal F\). On \(\mathbb N\), use the cofinite filter: \(f(n)\le g(n)\) for all sufficiently large \(n\).
signature: Filter.EventuallyLE.{u_1, u_2} {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [LE β] (l : Filter α) (f g : α → β) : Prop
